messages:
alexa: Quick sync — post go-live mini roadmap. We need to decide what goes into the 2-week stability sprint vs what we treat as backlog enhancements. Short thread, please react with :thumbsup: if you agree with the initial split below.

mike: Sounds good. What concrete criteria are we using to call something a bug vs an enhancement?

alexa: Proposed criteria:
- Severity P0/P1 user-facing correctness or data loss -> bug, must-fix in stability sprint.
- Performance regressions that increase p95 latency >20% for key flows -> bug.
- Feature polish, UX improvements, non-blocking customer asks -> enhancement/backlog.
- Small API contract changes = customer-impact review -> likely enhancement but schedule via canary.

sam: +1 to severity rules. Agree on special-case: customer-reported incorrect outputs for billing flows = immediate bug.

jessie: We should also consider prioritizing anything that hits multiple customers' production traffic (>3 customers) as P1 even if workaround exists.

alexa: Good call. I'll add that. Also: release-bot posted deploy note earlier: "deploy to prod v1.4.3 completed at 09:12 UTC". No major alerts but a handful of 502 spikes during the first hour.

mike: I pulled logs — 502s look like transient upstream timeouts when routing to model-variant-b. Example snippet:```HTTP 502 from model-proxy: dial tcp: i/o timeout```

sam: Can we mitigate short-term with routing policy tweak? Route 10% of traffic off model-variant-b to variant-a until we root cause.

alexa: Yes, propose: immediate routing change (10%->variant-a), open a ticket for root cause with eng-runtime. If spikes persist, roll back variant-b entirely.

jessie: For the backlog: customer asks for structured output for chat (3 customers). Recommend we schedule as enhancement in iteration after stability sprint. Need to estimate dev: 5-7 days.

mike: Also estimate for KV cache warmup improvement (p95 tail) — eng-runtime says 3 days to prototype, 2 more for QA. Could be in stability sprint as performance bug candidate.

alexa: Plan summary: 1) Stability sprint starts Monday (2 weeks). 2) Immediate actions: routing tweak + ticket to eng-runtime + watch p95. 3) P0/P1 rules apply for blocking regressions and multi-customer issues. 4) Enhancements (structured output, UX polish) go to post-stability backlog with estimates.

sam: I'll file the routing change and add a dashboard panel for variant-level errors.

jessie: I'll consolidate customer asks into a single spec doc and surface tradeoffs (API surface, backward compat).

mike: If we need to run a hotfix, call a quick release war room. release-bot: can we prebook an on-call handoff on Monday morning?

release-bot: On-call handoff scheduled for eng-oncall at 09:00 UTC Monday.

alexa: Thanks. If no objections by EOD today I'll lock the sprint plan and start moving tickets into the stability sprint board. :white_check_mark:

mike: +1

sam: +1

jessie: +1

alexa: Great — closing thread, I'll post the final board move and a short README for triage rules.
